description: Use when the user pastes an SPF record to explain or check before publishing. Returns mechanisms, qualifiers, syntax errors and the number of DNS-lookup terms. No DNS lookups; for a live domain use spf. Ex: 'Explain v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all'. Free trial without an API key: a few calls a day.
name: spf_parse
title: SPF record parser
